name: Mandala Public Knowledge System — Notion-first, website-ready
description: Design and launch a public knowledge resource for Mandala. Use Notion as the first publishing surface while keeping the content model and identifiers ready for a future website. Separate core knowledge, curated knowledge, public content, presentation, internal material, and personal information. Unknown visibility defaults to non-public. Each content item has one editing source and a stable ID. Draft is the default; deletion is never automatic. Publishing pipeline: Source, Validate, Resolve IDs and Relations, Dry Run, Review, Apply, Verify, Report.
deliverables: Define the information architecture and content layers.
Define stable IDs and a single editing source per content item.
Define public, internal, and personal visibility rules.
Define a website-ready content and relation model.
Specify validation, dry-run, review, apply, and verification.
phases: Inventory existing knowledge and content sources.
Define taxonomy, stable IDs, and source-of-truth rules.
Test the publishing pipeline on a small sample.
Review, document, and prepare the public launch.
